City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, APRIL 16, 2014 -
06:30 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 3/26/14 Special Joint Meeting and the 3/26/14 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-04-16 Item #8A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-04-16 Item #8B Warrants
8C.
Agreement to provide professional auditing services. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lembach
Approve the agreement with Pun & McGeady, LLP, to provide professional auditing services to the City of Encinitas (City) and the San Dieguito Water District (SDWD), for fiscal years 2013/14, 2014/15 and 2015/16, with an option to extend the agreement for two additional fiscal years.
2014-04-16 Item #8C Agreement for Professional Auditing Services
8D.
Adoption of Resolution 2014-27, authorizing the destruction of specific, non-essential, non-permanent records in accordance with City retention guidelines and pursuant to Government Code. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Adopt Resolution 2014-27 authorizing the destruction of specific, non-essential, non-permanent records.
2014-04-16 Item #8D Records Destruction
8E.
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2014-03, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Section 2.16.040 - Campaign Signs. Contact Person: City Attorney Sabine
Adopt Ordinance No. 2014-03, entitled "An Ordinance Amending Encinitas Municipal Code Section 2.16.040 for Purposes of Clarifying the Authority to Display Noncommercial Message Signs in Addition to Political Message Signs at Election Time."
2014-04-16 Item #8E Ordinance 2014-03 - Campaign Signs
8F.
Adoption of Ordinance No. 2014-02, amending Encinitas Municipal Code Chapters 11.08 and 11.09 to expand smoking regulations to include electronic cigarettes. Contact Person: Associate Planner Strong
Adopt Ordinance No. 2014-02, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Amending Chapters 11.08 and 11.09 of the Municipal Code to Expand Smoking Regulations to Include Electronic Cigarettes and Prohibit Smoking within 20 Feet of City Beaches, Parks, Trails, and Outdoor/Patio Dining Areas."
2014-04-16 Item #8F Ordinance 2014-02 - E-Cigarettes
8G.
Acceptance of a Donation of a Thermal Imaging Camera to the Encinitas Fire Department from the Firehouse Subs Public Safety Foundation, Inc. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Gallup
Accept the donation of a thermal imaging camera from Firehouse Subs Public Safety Foundation, Inc. in accordance with Administrative Policy Number F007 ("City Receipt of Donations").
2014-04-16 Item #8G Donation of Thermal Imaging Camera
8H.
Extension of Contract for beach grounds and landscape maintenance. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Superintendent Frenken
Authorize the first one (1) year renewal option of the Beach Grounds and Landscape Maintenance Contract to Excel Landscape, Inc.
2014-04-16 Item #8H Beach Grounds and Landscape Maintenance
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Council to meet with applicants for the Parks and Recreation Commission and make appointments to fill two vacancies for terms ending March 2017. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Hear each applicant briefly explain his/her qualifications and interest in serving on the Parks and Recreation Commission and, by vote, make two appointments for terms ending March 2017.
2014-04-16 Item #10A Parks and Rec Commission Applicants
10B.
Introduction of Ordinance No. 2014-05 amending Municipal Code Section 2.20 regarding duties and salary for the elected Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Council Members. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Introduce Ordinance No. 2014-05 entitled "An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas Amending Encinitas Municipal Code Section 2.20 Regarding Duties and Salary for Elected Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Council Members."
2014-04-16 Item #10B Ordinance 2014-05 - Duties and Salary for Mayor, Deputy Mayor and Council
10C.
Approval of a resolution regarding the distribution of public funds received from the Encinitas Sister City Steering Committee to a local non-profit organization. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Stauffer
Adopt Resolution 2014-32, authorizing the distribution of public funds received from the Encinitas Sister City Steering Committee to a local non-profit organization.
2014-04-16 Item #10C Sister City Funds
10D.
Report from City Council Subcommittee regarding Encinitas Ranch Golf Association (ERGA). Contact Persons: Council Member Kranz and Council Member Shaffer
Receive report from the City Council Subcommittee and take action on the subcommittee's recommendations.
2014-04-16 Item #10D City Council ERGA Subcommittee
10D.
Report from City Council Subcommittee regarding Encinitas Ranch Golf Association (ERGA). Contact Persons: Council Member Kranz and Council Member Shaffer
Receive report from the City Council Subcommittee and take action on the subcommittee's recommendations.
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Review of the Interstate 5 Widening Project status update. Contact Person: Associate Planner Strong (standing agenda item per Council direction)
Receive report and provide direction to staff as appropriate.
2014-04-16 Item #11A I-5 Widening Update
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM There are no Council Member initiated Items.
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2014-04-16 Item #15 City Manager Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
